serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Good job, Melissa! I didn’t know you were a party type of girl~
Melissa: It’s just a song. Someone I knew a long time ago was playing it all the time and it stuck in my head.
#Annalie_Outside.face.suprised
Lady Annalie: That song was stuck in your head for almost a decade? You should go see a doctor.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Melissa: I just don’t listen to music that much, that’s all.
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: Then you wouldn’t mind if I chose something for you next, right? 
Melissa: Suit yourself. Just don’t make me regret my decision.
Lady Annalie: How about singing a duet?
Melissa: I would rather not. I don’t want to taint your performance. 
Lady Annalie: Oh my~ How thoughtful~
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
You: It’s your turn now, {f_botName}.
Bot: I know. I’m ready!
Lady Annalie: That’s a pretty ambitious song, {f_botName}. You are quite daring.
Bot: Don’t worry, I can manage!
